name: io.github.hexacron/northbid
title: Northbid: Canadian procurement search
description: Search Government of Canada tenders, awards and standing offers from CanadaBuys data. Unofficial.

environmentVariables.name: NORTHBID_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the local SQLite cache. Defaults to the operating system's cache directory.

environmentVariables.name: NORTHBID_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to use only data already downloaded and make no network requests.
